faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the TRAI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications for the TRAI Recruitment 2026 is 22 September 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the TRAI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 4 vacancies are available for the posts of Section Officer, Principal Private Secretary, and Junior Hindi Translator in the TRAI Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the eligibility criteria for the Section Officer post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Section Officer post, candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree from a recognized university and have proficiency in computer operations. Additionally, they should be holding an analogous post or have 6 years of experience as an Assistant in Level-6.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the posts advertised by TRAI?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts advertised by TRAI in this recruitment drive is 56 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per the existing government rules and regulations.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Hindi Translator post?
faq.answer: The Junior Hindi Translator post is offered a salary in Pay Level-6, which ranges from Rs. 35,400 to Rs. 1,12,400 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the TRAI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the TRAI Recruitment 2026. Candidates can apply without paying any application charges.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these TRAI posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these TRAI posts is based on deputation. Candidates will be selected based on their suitability for deputation to the advertised positions.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from any state apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for posts located in New Delhi. While candidates from any state can apply if they meet the eligibility criteria, the job location is in Delhi.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of TRAI?
faq.answer: The official website of the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) is https://www.trai.gov.in. Candidates can visit this website for more information and updates.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are generally required for the application process?
faq.answer: Candidates are usually required to upload scanned copies of their photograph, signature, educational certificates, experience certificates, and any other relevant documents as specified in the official notification.
